import asyncio
import contextlib


async def save(x):
    pass


def lock_for(x):
    return contextlib.nullcontext()


def alock_for(x):
    return contextlib.AsyncExitStack()


# CASE async_with_per_item expect=fire
async def p1(items):
    for item in items:
        async with alock_for(item):
            pass


# CASE async_with_two_managers expect=fire
async def p2(items):
    for item in items:
        async with alock_for(item), alock_for(item + 1):
            pass


# CASE async_with_parenthesized_multiline expect=fire
async def p3(items):
    for item in items:
        async with (
            alock_for(item) as a,
            alock_for(item) as b,
        ):
            pass


# CASE async_with_comment_in_header expect=fire
async def p4(items):
    for item in items:
        async with (  # one lock per item
            alock_for(item) as a
        ):
            pass


# CASE async_with_string_with_colon expect=fire
async def p5(items, session):
    for item in items:
        async with session.get("https://x.test/a:b") as resp:
            pass


# CASE sync_with_per_item expect=pass
async def p6(items):
    for item in items:
        with lock_for(item):
            print(item)


# CASE sync_with_after_async_with_line expect=pass
async def p7(items, pool):
    async with pool:
        pass
    for item in items:
        with lock_for(item):
            print(item)


# CASE sync_with_body_mentions_async_with_string expect=pass
async def p8(items):
    for item in items:
        with lock_for(item):
            print("async with x:")


# CASE while_async_with expect=fire
async def p9(queue):
    while queue:
        async with alock_for(queue.pop()):
            pass


# CASE gather_in_loop expect=fire
async def p10(groups):
    for group in groups:
        await asyncio.gather(*(save(x) for x in group))


# CASE comprehension_await expect=fire
async def p11(items):
    return [await save(x) for x in items]


# CASE comprehension_await_two_filters expect=fire
async def p12(items):
    return [await save(x) for x in items if x if x > 1]


# CASE comprehension_five_filters expect=fire
async def p13(items):
    return [await save(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if x > 4]


# CASE dict_comprehension_await expect=fire
async def p14(items):
    return {x: await save(x) for x in items}


# CASE async_for_stream expect=pass
async def p15(stream):
    async for row in stream:
        await save(row)


# CASE for_body_comment_only_await expect=pass
async def p16(items):
    for item in items:
        print(item)  # await later


# CASE for_else_await expect=pass
async def p17(items):
    for item in items:
        if item:
            break
    else:
        await save(None)


# CASE async_with_in_nested_def expect=pass
async def p18(items):
    jobs = []
    for item in items:

        async def job(item=item):
            async with alock_for(item):
                pass

        jobs.append(job())
    await asyncio.gather(*jobs)
